review: Reviewed the release ui-09bc6b371eca (source 4cf45804; Core and Smart are the same ui commit, Smart in distr/smart). smart-base.js changed: a mounted element subscribes to SF.language changes in connectedCallback and re-renders on a change, and unsubscribes in disconnectedCallback before onDisconnected(); the cleanup lesson's rule (override onConnected/onDisconnected, keep super.onDisconnected()) is unchanged and still sufficient. loader.js changed: sfSmartPath is optional (Smart resolves to <sfPath>/smart), and component packages are declared in SF_BOOT_CONFIG.packages with their own rule file (SF.RuleLoader.registerPackage). No lesson sets sfSmartPath; local-components still registers its class by hand after SF.loadSmartBase() and the Loader still does not derive a path from a tag name, so that lesson stays true. No attribute, property, event, slot, nesting rule, cleanup path or asset reference the eight lessons teach changes, so none of them changes.
